note: Record-level events the committed data cannot infer. Everything else in the change log is derived: sweeps and evidence additions from evidence.sweeps, re-reviews from lastReviewedOn, artifact re-checks from evidence-verification.json, calculated planning dates from directives.json, and lapsed reviews from the build date. Only two things leave no trace in the current data and therefore belong here. A correction applied to a published record, because the corrected record shows the new value and not the change. And the narrowing of a context-watchlist item, because an item that stops being watched is removed and the removal is the event. A narrowing that happened because the awaited artifact arrived carries promotedToEvidenceId; the matching evidence-added entry is derived from the sweep log, so a promotion publishes two entries and each names the other's record. The register is empty because no such event has been recorded since the change log was built, not because none can occur: scripts/validate-data.mjs refuses an event naming a record the dataset does not hold, so an entry added here fails the gate rather than publishing a link to nothing.
